sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN y.trips END AS target_trips, CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-12-28' THEN y.trips END AS post_christmas_trips, w.snow_mm AS snow_mm_21_dec FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2024-12-21', DATE '2024-12-28') ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
